name: visualforge
description: 视铸：ComfyUI 本地多模态工坊

scripts.manager: node scripts/check-node.cjs && npm run dev -w comfymanager
scripts.dev:all: node scripts/check-node.cjs && concurrently -n app,mgr -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @visualforge/frontend" "npm run dev -w comfymanager"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @visualforge/frontend && npm run build -w comfymanager
